subject.title: feat: add hosted feed envelope verifier

question: Should this hosted-feed verifier primitive land as the DSSE/Ed25519 trust contract for signed ClawHub feeds after it signs decoded serialized payload bytes?
rationale: This PR defines a new remote-feed signature boundary that follow-up marketplace config and refresh work will rely on, so maintainer/security intent is needed after the concrete DSSE bug is fixed.

options.title: Fix Decoded-Body DSSE Before Acceptance
options.body: Require the verifier to decode the envelope payload before PAE and add proof against a standard DSSE-shaped envelope before accepting this primitive.

options.title: Accept Base64url-Text Signing
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally define an OpenClaw-specific DSSE-like variant, but that would diverge from DSSE tooling and should be documented as a deliberate contract.

options.title: Pause Until Consumer Stack Lands
options.body: Hold this standalone primitive until config, refresh, and CLI trust-state behavior can be reviewed as one complete signed-feed path.

recommendation.title: Fix Decoded-Body DSSE Before Acceptance
recommendation.body: Require the verifier to decode the envelope payload before PAE and add proof against a standard DSSE-shaped envelope before accepting this primitive.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assignee and reviewer who requested the DSSE/security-boundary changes on this PR.
